noise_assumptions.notes: Illustrative assumptions only; official benchmark noise model determines measured results.

design_rationale: The processor uses three qubits for the required QFT-3 benchmark. A linear topology connects adjacent qubits with bidirectional links. RX, RY and RZ provide single-qubit rotations, while CX provides the entangling operation. Bidirectional links help reduce direction-reversal overhead. The official benchmark measures transpilation overhead and fidelity under its prescribed noise model.
